requirement: enabling the dsh-gpw sub-plugin must activate it; every service it reads must be declared in inject, and the folder gate must install its tools/pre-execute listener

assertions.symptom: dsh: warning: 1 entry did not activate dsh-gpw (@twinsearth/w2m-dsh-plugin/gpw): Error: cannot get property "tools" without inject
assertions.cause: ctx.tools.guard was read while inject named only permissionPresets
assertions.fix: inject = ['permissionPresets', 'tools']; guard read is defensive for hosts without the guard extension
assertions.regression: test/gpw-activation.test.mjs mounts apply() behind a strict Cordis-like Proxy that throws on undeclared reads; 12/12 (with gpw-folder-policy) pass
